licence: Provided by the author for Civgraph
received: 2026-11-21: linked in his answer 2.2 in the catalogue-review response document

source.sharing: Shared with named accounts only: the sheet itself is not public. Its content is published here, credited to him; the original is not linked from the site.

transcription: Every cell with text, a link, a fill or a comment, verbatim, with the merged ranges; written by scripts/ingest/idb-phelim/import-lea-sheet.mjs. `arrangements` and `instruments` restate the two tabs one entry per cell or row and add nothing: an arrangement's from/to are the years of the first and last rows its merge covers.

legend.List: Grey = no census report coverage, red = not mentioned in census report, white = mentioned in census report

linkCheck.about: Each distinct link fetched once, one at a time (an Internet Archive page by its item's metadata), for its HTTP status and page title. "SKIPPED-subscription": a subscription site, not fetched and not linked from the site.
